questions.text: Which Memphis label helped define the sound of Southern hip-hop in the 1990s?
questions.note: Hypnotize Minds helped bring Memphis rap's dark, independent sound to a national audience.

questions.text: Which Memphis institution is known for preserving the legacy of Stax Records?
answers: Stax Museum of American Soul Music
questions.correct: Stax Museum of American Soul Music
